note: RER canon for the Rail Profiles page, tools/make_rer_profile_lines.py and railsim/metro_profile.py (Ben's rulings). RER-n is TRI by KMZ colour: 1 A, 2 B, 3 C, 4 D, 5 E. modes: station 'under' or 'surface' (at grade); fixed: station rail level, 'abs' metres NAVD88 or 'off' metres from ground; sections: canon structure between two stations (m: covered = covered way, cut and cover; deep = deep bore); deck: rail at yard level under a deck, ground = DEM top minus 'drop'. rivers: bed 'dem' = the canon riverbed in the ground raster, else pool minus bed_below_pool_m (no survey); in tunnel the rail stays bed - 9.1 m (RER, sunk box sections) / bed - 7.5 m (Metro twin tubes). 2026-10-26 (Ben): the Union Terminal box is one level for A, B and D (135.7 m); B and D run on the north viaduct (Northside 162.5, Arlington 165.9, Camp Washington 165.2 m) into the Straight box (151.64 m) and the bores to Western; the yard-level deck under the boulevard is gone.
